corrections: Translated the female and cursed mannequin names, Junimo and Retro catalogue descriptions, all ten dining-room, cubby, attic and corner-room renovation records, and Marnie’s adoption prompt directly from English.
Preserved each renovation’s three-field title, outcome and selection-prompt grammar, all slash delimiters and both mannequin body markers while applying established джунимо terminology.
Added and negatively exercised a dedicated renovation-field validator; read every add/remove and expand/shrink pair side by side and refined the attic addition for clear spatial meaning.
